note: Private campground beside Kansas Lake, the sites on gravel pads in an open field set back from the wooded shore; 34 of the 38 sites are full hookup. One cabin, two docks, canoe/kayak/paddle-boat rentals, mini golf and a game room. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: $37.40 a night including tax (weekly/monthly/seasonal also sold), 34 full-hookup + 4 water/electric 20/30/50-amp sites, showers, store, WiFi, season Apr 28-Oct 15, phone or RoverPass request booking up to 12 months ahead. Not waterfront kept (pads in an open field behind a wooded shore). Price gate passes; Google 4.7 (57).
flags: Private gate: posted rate $37.40 a night including tax (operator page, (c) 2026), under US$50; RoverPass shows $40.00 for its cheapest type; a Google review from about July 2026 says '$43 a night'. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Minneapolis 165 km). Good Sam not checked on the page; none claimed.
Google Maps: 4.7 from 57 reviews (place at 43.9165,-94.7195, phone 507-380-2093, website the stored godaddysites page). Presence passes (working site + phone, Google 25+).

Long-stay: the operator posts a nightly rate first and also sells weekly, monthly ($450 + electricity) and seasonal ($1,750 + electricity) stays. Recent Google reviews are transient one-night stays ('just staying one night on our way home to Wisconsin from South Dakota'; 'well worth the 25 mile detour from the interstate'). Not read as mostly seasonal; occupancy not measurable (RoverPass request-to-book, no live grid).

Waterfront: keep not waterfront. On imagery the RV loop and its south row sit in an open field west of the lake, with a continuous tree band between every pad and the water (about 55-100 m to the shore). Lead only: a Google review (about July 2026) says 'I was in spot #28 that's just a cpl hundred yards from the lake with no obstruction of the view'; a review cannot carry a view value and site 28 was not placed, so no change.
Pin 43.91814,-94.71406 is in the middle of the RV loop: OK.
Phone 507-380-2093 matches the operator page and Google. Website https://sandscountrycovecampground.godaddysites.com/ is live and the operator's own (GoDaddy builder site).
